title: Fort Steele Resort and RV Park

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Our RV resort is a fantastic place to stay whether you're a travelling explorer, on a family vacation, or looking for a place to stay long-term. We offer over 110 serviced sites (30 or 50 amp/water & sewer) plus a dozen Unserviced sites. The majority of our Full Hook Up sites are pull-throughs for your convenience. Our RV sites are wheelchair accessible and pet friendly. Each site has a picnic table and there are community fire pits located throughout the resort. All sites have access to the outdoor swimming pool, playground, sports field and basketball hoop. There are free hot showers for registered guests only and a coin operated Laundromat with single and triple front load washing

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: We offer over 60 tenting sites that are mostly located in a heavily treed area with water taps for everyone to share. Each site has a picnic table and some have their own fire pit. Because of the heavy trees not every site has its own fire pit, but we do have community fire pits for everyone's enjoyment as well as a covered shelter to share and available portable fire pits for rent. All sites have access to the outdoor swimming pool, playground, sports field and basketball hoop. There are free hot showers for registered guests only and a coin operated Laundromat with single and triple front load washing machines. See all the amenities and activities the resort has to offer. services.name: Cabin stay
services.desc: Get back to nature in our log cabin. A one room cabin with a double set of bunk beds, double futon/couch, table with benches, microwave and electric heater. There is a picnic table on the porch and a fire pit not far away to enjoy. The cabin sleeps a maximum of 6 people. There is no running water in the cabin. Please bring your own bedding or we can supply it for a small fee. The cabin rental includes access to the outdoor swimming pool, playground, sports field and basketball hoop. There are free hot showers for registered guests only and a coin operated Laundromat with single and triple front load washing machines. See all the amenities and activities the resort has to offer.
